lesson_intro.heading: Cloud Engineer · PM-2.3
lesson_intro.board_text:
Security Groups in Practice
Finova · finova-dev · ap-south-1

Why before how:
Wrong SG rules = either outage or open-to-world disaster.

Mental model:
Security Group = stateful allow-list on the ENI. Default deny inbound.

You will: watch → learn → practice one navigation.
lesson_intro.ren_voice: Naan Ren. Wrong SG rules = either outage or open-to-world disaster. Mental model: Security Group = stateful allow-list on the ENI. Default deny inbound. Naan demonstrate panren, neenga practice. Least privilege and Region — non-negotiable.

whiteboard_intro.board_text:
Security Groups in Practice
• Security Group = stateful allow-list on the ENI. Default deny inbound.
• Mistake: 0.0.0.0/0 on SSH 'temporarily'.
• Habit: Source should be another SG or known CIDR — never lazy open.
